articles.title: Help EFF Solve an Issue That's Bigger than Creepy Ads
articles.summary: Microsoft drops 167 patches including a SharePoint zero-day and Windows Defender's 'BlueHammer' flaw, while Chrome notches its fourth zero-day fix. AI might be finding vulns faster than humans can patch them—delicious irony.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Canvas gets pwned by extortionists who defaced login pages with ransom demands, disrupting education nationwide. Because nothing says 'digital learning' like a good old-fashioned shakedown of America's schools.

articles.title: Fleet launches autonomous endpoint management platform to counter AI-accelerated exploits
articles.summary: Cisco's SD-WAN Controller gets hit with a perfect CVSS 10.0 auth bypass that's being actively exploited. When your network security appliance becomes the highway in, chef's kiss to the irony gods.

articles.title: Victory! End-to-End Encrypted RCS Comes to Apple and Android Chats
articles.summary: Instagram kills its barely-used E2E encryption feature after years of empty promises. Meta once again proves that privacy theater is easier than actual privacy engineering.

articles.title: EFF Launches New Offline Campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid
articles.summary: Victory lap time: Apple finally enables E2E encryption for RCS chats with Android. Only took them forever, but cross-platform privacy is no longer an oxymoron.

articles.title: On-Prem Microsoft Exchange Server CVE-2026-42897 Exploited via Crafted Email
articles.summary: OpenAI gets tagged via TanStack supply chain attack that compromised two employee devices. The AI overlords aren't immune to good old-fashioned package poisoning—humans 1, machines 0.

articles.title: CISA Adds Cisco SD-WAN CVE-2026-20182 to KEV After Admin Access Exploits
articles.summary: On-prem Exchange Server gets actively exploited via crafted email in CVE-2026-42897. Microsoft's gift that keeps on giving—this time with XSS-flavored spoofing attacks.

articles.title: How Trump’s New Counterterrorism Strategy Puts You at Risk
articles.summary: Trump's new counterterrorism strategy turns political enemies into state enemies with chilling 'we will find you and kill you' rhetoric. Domestic surveillance state says what now?

articles.title: Cyber Pioneers Ponder Past as Prologue
articles.summary: EFF launches campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid, who started editing at age 12 and became a prolific open-source blogger. Digital freedom fighters come in all ages—this one's just getting started.

articles.title: OpenLoop Health confirms January 2026 Data breach affecting 716,000
articles.summary: House Homeland Security Committee demands answers from Instructure after Canvas hack exposed 9,000+ schools. When script kiddies pwn the entire education system, Congress finally pays attention.
